brief:
Suhail Abu Shawish, a 50-year-old craftsman, sits beneath a sliver of light filtering through an opening in a small tent pitched over the rubble of a refugee camp, repairing musical instruments that survived the Israeli offensive beginning October 7, according to the Palestine News Network. Working in makeshift quarters constructed atop destruction, Abu Shawish restores instruments salvaged from the campaign.

The effort to reconstruct playable instruments represents an attempt to preserve Gaza's musical heritage and cultural continuity amid the ongoing conflict. Musicians across the territory have continued their work despite widespread devastation from the military operations. Abu Shawish's repair work demonstrates efforts by Gaza's cultural practitioners to maintain artistic traditions and creative expression through the crisis.

title: Gaza musician rebuilds instruments amid destruction
